# privacy-scan allow-list (read by .github/scripts/privacy-scan.py).
#   value <string>        a known-safe value, allowed in every file (exact match, case-insensitive)
#   skip <rule|*> <glob>  do not apply a rule to matching paths (rules: mac ipv4 email key nm name blob)
# Only generic, documented values belong here. Never add a value that belongs to one device or one person's
# network (serial numbers, MAC / Bluetooth addresses, network names): fix the file instead.
#
# Licence and notice texts carry their authors' published addresses.
skip email *Notice-*.txt
skip email *NOTICE*
skip email *LICENSE*
skip email *COPYING*
#
# The VMs' NAT network chosen by gvm.sh / the app (host side of the tap gvmtap0), not a real network.
value 10.250.0.1
value 10.250.0.0
# Locally administered example MAC of the unit tests and of gvm.sh's default guest NICs (0a:1c = "GVM"), not a device address.
value 0a:1c:00:00:00:01
value 0a:1c:47:56:4d:01
value 0a:1c:47:56:4d:02
